+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
+    """Return additional suffixes for MIME types affected by QTBUG-116905.
+
+    Affected Qt versions are greater than 6.2.2 and less than 6.7.0.
+    """
+    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3") and
+            not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0")):
+        return set()
+
+    entries = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    python_suffixes = set()
+    for mime in (entry for entry in entries if "/" in entry):
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            python_suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mimetype in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mimetype.startswith(mime[:-1])
+            )
+        else:
+            python_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+    return python_suffixes - entries
+
